results.problem: Online coloring of k-colorable graphs in the random-arrival model
results.bound: O(k^3 \log^2 k \log^4 n) \text{ colors in expectation}
results.quote: Theorem 1. In the random-order model, when both n and k are known in advance, there exists a randomized online algorithm that colors any k-colorable n-vertex graph using O(k^3 log^2 k log^4 n) colors in expectation.

results.problem: Online coloring for general graphs in the random-arrival model
results.quote: Theorem 2. In the random-order model, when n is known in advance, there exists a randomized online algorithm that attains a competitive ratio of \widetilde{O}(n^{2/3}).
